status: The layout spec for the Vivarium's whole, slot V (the Vivarium, whole and up close) of lvgl-switch.md §3: every drawn region names its word or composition, the states rest and empty, the conditions docked and away, the focus as data, the events, the bottom line, the strings and the masters
note: The one home of the numbers of the Vivarium's whole, transcribed from station-layouts.md (The Vivarium: the whole and one mibi up close) and its wireframes 18-vivarium-whole.svg to 18b-vivarium-whole-empty.svg. Rectangles are [x, y, w, h] in screen pixels; `at` offsets are from the region's own origin. The whole is the living window edge to edge, the residents walking in it, the with-you bed at its right, and the strip of bays along the foot; nothing else is on the stage. Its closer level is one mibi up close (habitat.json).
purpose: Every mibi at home in the room shown, at its size, alive in one full-width window, and the rooms and the places along the foot: the player sees the household of one room (who is home, who is out with the Companion, how many places are free), which rooms there are and where there is room, chooses a room, buys another, and chooses one mibi to come closer to, with one press. Home's panel is the same place in a glance among the device's sections; Idle is the same painting with no frame and nothing to choose; the whole is the place with the keys in hand. Reads first: the residents; then the bays

notes.motion: Reduced motion (props.motion false; UI designer, 2026-10-10 02:29): every event on this screen is a cut to its end, so the host sends hold 0 and runs what follows an event's end (a hand-off, a jump, the next state) on the frame of the key; nothing waits on a still frame. look and back are cuts to the other level. A press that ends an event with `cut: true` also acts (habitat.json notes.cut); no event here cuts.
notes.painting: the window shows rows 120 to 560 of Idle's painting (frame.json idle.regions.vivarium.theWhole) at 1:1: one painting a light, never cropped and enlarged; a resident at y on Idle stands at y − 80 here
notes.strip: the strip row [16, 488, 992, 64] is two slate panes (rooms and places; ux-rooms.md §1a): the rooms pane with the room chips and the new-room chip, the places pane with the eight places of the room shown. One mibi up close keeps its own strip until its ticket (R6)
notes.nothing else: no card, no modules, no stamp, no words in the window but the focused resident's name tag; nothing is amber
notes.residents: every mibi at home walks; the carried set sleeps on the bed while the Companion is docked (each sleeper a resident target, with no lift); while it is away, the bed shows the Companion mark and the carried mibis are only on the strip, each tile with the outline glyph
notes.paintingLands: a painting that lands while its mibi is on screen waits for the next fresh draw (the whole opened again, a wake): never a swap in view

travel.note: G10 (game-design.md, Reconciled): N = the awake, unfocused moving residents; on each group tick a resident whose rest has run out starts, longest rest first, while travelling < min(max, max(capMin, ⌈N/capDiv⌉)), max the ceiling (the game designer: 2 moving at once; the stills count too); then, while travelling < ⌈N/floorDiv⌉, one that has rested ≥ minRest ticks starts, and never above the ceiling; ≤ airborne in the air at once; the face reads these for Home, Idle and the whole (one place, one rule)

walk.note: the walk on the rooms' levels (arch-rooms.md §2; the game designer, gd-age-rooms.md Part 2): at most max(1, ⌊N/raisedDiv⌋) residents on the raised levels, N the residents shown, 1 trip in levelOneIn changes level when the cap allows; speed[stage] = [px, own ticks of 80 ms] along the major axis: a juvenile 2 px a tick, an adult 1, an elder 1 every 2

night.note: G7 in own ticks (80 ms): one stir every stir[0]–stir[1] across the household while one is asleep, never a focused sleeper, never in the afterCurl ticks after its own curl, never the last one twice, none while one wanders; when every resident is asleep, one wakes every wander[0]–wander[1] from the end of the last curl (juveniles first, then adults, never an elder, never the last one twice), travels to 1–2 waypoints each ≤ reach px away, rests breathing until awake[0]–awake[1] after its wake (at least two breaths) and curls where it stands; its rest is never written

rest.note: the game designer's R1 (Station M1): each sleep group settles and wakes across a windowS window from the light change, one resident at a time, member k of n at window start + ⌊k·W/n⌋ + (seed mod max(1, ⌊W/(2n)⌋)) s; restOf (views/home-props.mjs) is the only reader, the face sees `rest`

initial: by the save: no housed mibi, empty; else rest
stateRule: rest: at least one mibi housed in the room shown (at home or out with the Companion). empty: no mibi housed in the room shown (the whole Vivarium may still have one in another); the window with the bed (the nest alone while docked, the nest and its mark while away, as Home and Idle), the places pane's free places and the frame. A region with `inStates` exists only in those states; docked and away are conditions of both

walk.box: figure box x 16..1008−W, feetY the room's levels (the union of their rows in the window's coordinates: top(F.x) of each level to its bottom, the main floor's down to 471); the ground's top row 296 is the walk's only when no room is chosen
walk.keepOutRule: a figure meets K exactly when F.x + ⌈W/2⌉ > 752 and feetY > 353, in every bed state; K is the sleepers' tags: left 840 − 88 (the widest tag on the leftmost place), top = the sleepers' tag top less 40, so that a walker's tag, feetY + 16 to + 40, stays above them; the sleepers' tag top is 456 − curlH − 32 (396 with the measured curl height 28); the rect is derived from the measured curls by station/tools/make-keepout.mjs (and checked), never typed
walk.start: one draw r: the level (1 start in rules.walk.levelOneIn on a raised level while the raised cap allows), then room_point on it (⌈w/4⌉ inside each end), up to 8 draws, off keepOut; fallback main's leftmost point at its top
walk.waypoint: one draw for the level (1 trip in levelOneIn changes level through a join, cap allowing), then room_point on the target level; rejected if max(|dx|,|dy|) < 32 or the path leaves the level or meets a keep-out; a change of level is the three legs of arch-rooms §2.2; after 8 rejections, idle again
walk.rule: each walks with its feet in the band, as on Idle 80 px higher; its keep-out reaches the sleepers' tags (Idle shows none)

resident.order: by the feet's y, lower in front (drawn later), left first on a tie; the bed and its sleepers sort as one, at the bed's foot (y 472)

asleep.when: clip curl, asleep or stir; walker form in wake, breathe, hop, walk; a one-shot under way when focus lands shows its end state's form

asleep.ring: feet form on the ink box: [x + w/2 − 56, feet − 12, 112, 24]
asleep.tag: over the ink: top feet − 120, centred on x + w/2, slid 8 px inside the window, no lift

asleep.spot: [x + w/2 − 56, feet − 12, 112, 24]: no other resident's waypoint or start point has its ground point in it
asleep.focus: no curl, wake, stir or wander begins while focused; a due change starts when focus leaves
